trustedProxies.label: Trusted proxies
trustedProxies.hint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges whose forwarded headers are trusted. Empty: forwarded headers are ignored.
trustedProxies.consequence: Trusting a range that covers untrusted hosts lets clients spoof their IP address. Restart required.

discoveryEnabled.label: Enable discovery
discoveryEnabled.hint: Broadcast via mDNS / DNS-SD on the LAN. Off by default; changes apply without a restart.

discoveryServiceName.label: Service name prefix
discoveryServiceName.hint: The backend appends a short ID. Empty uses CPA-<ShortID>.

discoverySubtypes.label: Protocol subtypes
discoverySubtypes.hint: Empty uses the five default protocols. Missing leading _ is added; invalid entries are ignored.

discoveryInterfacesInclude.label: Include interfaces
discoveryInterfacesInclude.hint: Empty auto-selects physical LAN interfaces. Use names or prefix patterns ending in *.

discoveryInterfacesExclude.label: Exclude interfaces
discoveryInterfacesExclude.hint: Use names or prefix patterns ending in *. Exclusions take priority over inclusions.

discoveryAuthRequired.label: Advertise authentication requirement
discoveryAuthRequired.hint: On by default. Broadcast metadata only; does not change actual API authentication.

discoveryAdvertiseManagement.label: Advertise management service
discoveryAdvertiseManagement.hint: Off by default. Only announces the management service exists; does not change remote access permissions.

serverExtras.discoveryHint: Requires multicast-capable physical interfaces and a non-loopback listener. Docker usually needs host networking; reachability is not guaranteed.

additions.oauthHint: These provider settings apply only to OAuth/file-backed credentials, not API-key credentials.
additions.liveRelayHint: Relay WebRTC audio and DataChannel traffic in the proxy process. Inbound UDP must be reachable. Keep ICE credentials out of screenshots and logs.

routingSessionAffinitySubagents.label: Subagent session affinity
routingSessionAffinitySubagents.hint: Enabled by default; only effective when session affinity is enabled. Subagents inherit their parent's credential to reuse caches. Disable to distribute subagents across the credential pool for greater concurrency.

saveCooldownStatus.label: Persist cooldown status
saveCooldownStatus.hint: Save per-credential cooldown status in .cds files beside auth files. Disabled by default; otherwise status is kept only in memory.

transientErrorCooldownSeconds.label: Transient error cooldown (seconds)
transientErrorCooldownSeconds.hint: Cooldown for upstream 408/500/502/503/504/520–526 errors. 0 uses the default 60 seconds; a negative value disables this cooldown.

videoResultAuthCacheTTL.label: Video result credential cache TTL
videoResultAuthCacheTTL.hint: How long video IDs remain bound to the credential that created them. Use a duration such as 30m or 3h; default: 3h.

claudeHeaderTimezone.label: Fallback timezone
claudeHeaderTimezone.hint: IANA timezone for the cloaked currentDate, e.g. Asia/Singapore, or Local for the backend host's timezone. The credential JSON's timezone takes priority.

claudeModelLevelCooling.label: Model-level cooldown
claudeModelLevelCooling.hint: Apply Claude quota cooldowns only to the requested model, rather than all models sharing the credential. Disabled by default.

claudeDisableCloakMode.label: Disable request cloaking
claudeDisableCloakMode.hint: Disable the Claude Code CLI disguise and system prompt replacement; pass through the original system prompt. Credential files can override this with cloak_mode. Default: false (automatic cloaking for non-Claude-Code clients).
claudeDisableCloakMode.consequence: Claude requests are sent with your real client fingerprint, which can get the account flagged.

claudeCodeDisableCloakingModelList.label: Disable model ID cloaking
claudeCodeDisableCloakingModelList.hint: Return original model IDs in Anthropic model list responses instead of cloaked IDs. Disabled by default.

codexDisableCloaking.label: Disable request cloaking
codexDisableCloaking.hint: Stop forcing official Codex User-Agent and Originator headers on HTTP/SSE and WebSocket requests. Disabled by default.
codexDisableCloaking.consequence: Codex requests are sent with your real client fingerprint, which can get the account flagged.

codexModelLevelCooling.label: Model-level cooldown
codexModelLevelCooling.hint: Apply usage_limit_reached quota cooldowns only to the requested model, rather than all models sharing the credential. Disabled by default.

codexStreamBootstrapBuffering.label: Buffer stream bootstrap
codexStreamBootstrapBuffering.hint: Hold initial empty events and heartbeats to allow credential failover on early overload or rate-limit rejections. Disabled by default. Delays response headers and may trigger client or reverse-proxy timeouts; buffering has frame and byte budgets.

codexStreamBootstrapTimeout.label: Stream bootstrap timeout
codexStreamBootstrapTimeout.hint: Optional buffering time limit, e.g. 20s. Default: 0 (unlimited time; frame and byte budgets still apply). Checked as upstream frames arrive; not a hard deadline for every network stall. Headers may still wait for translated output.

codexOptimizeMultiAgentV2.label: Optimize multi-agent v2
codexOptimizeMultiAgentV2.hint: Optimize official Codex multi-agent requests: refresh spawn_agent model details, remove message parameter encryption, normalize agent_message content, and convert it to user messages for non-Codex protocols. Disabled by default.

codexOrphanDelegationCompatibility.label: Orphan delegation compatibility
codexOrphanDelegationCompatibility.hint: For X-Openai-Subagent: collab_spawn requests, convert orphan codex_app/create_thread and codex_app/send_message_to_thread outputs without a valid matching call into user messages. Disabled by default.

codexResponseSteering.label: Response steering
codexResponseSteering.hint: Experimental full-duplex Codex Responses WebSockets. Each socket stays bound to one upstream account and model; accepted input is never replayed. Disabled by default.

antigravityConnectionPoolEnabled.label: Enable connection pooling
antigravityConnectionPoolEnabled.hint: Reuse upstream HTTP/1.1 connections. Default: false (short-lived connections).

antigravityConnectionPoolIdleTimeout.label: Idle connection timeout
antigravityConnectionPoolIdleTimeout.hint: How long idle connections remain in the pool. Default: 30s; capped at 210s. Zero or a negative duration switches to short-lived connections.

antigravityConnectionPoolMaxIdleConnsPer.label: Maximum idle connections per host
antigravityConnectionPoolMaxIdleConnsPer.hint: Maximum idle connections retained per upstream host per credential. Default: 2; capped at 100. Zero uses Go's default of 2; a negative value switches to short-lived connections.

xaiInjectXSearch.label: Inject x_search
xaiInjectXSearch.hint: Add xAI's native x_search tool when absent from the request, including tool_choice.allowed_tools when applicable. Disabled by default.

codexLiveMediaRelayEnabled.label: Enable media relay
codexLiveMediaRelayEnabled.hint: Terminate and relay Codex Live WebRTC media in this process. Requires inbound UDP reachability. Disabled by default to preserve direct media connections.

codexLiveMediaRelayMaxSessions.label: Maximum concurrent media sessions
codexLiveMediaRelayMaxSessions.hint: Blank or 0 uses the default of 32 sessions. A custom UDP range must provide at least two ports per session.

codexLiveMediaRelayDisablePrivateRemoteI.label: Block private remote IP candidates
codexLiveMediaRelayDisablePrivateRemoteI.hint: Default: false, allowing private candidates for local or trusted-network clients. Enable to reject downstream SDP candidates targeting private, loopback, link-local, or unspecified IPs and reduce internal-network exposure; local connections may fail.

codexLiveMediaRelayPublicIP.label: Advertised public IP
codexLiveMediaRelayPublicIP.hint: Optional public IPv4 or IPv6 address to advertise when the proxy is behind 1:1 NAT. Enter an IP address, not a hostname.

codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMin.label: Minimum UDP port
codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMin.hint: Set both UDP bounds to 0 for system allocation, or specify an inclusive continuous range with at least twice the effective session limit in ports.

codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMax.label: Maximum UDP port
codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMax.hint: Must be at least the minimum port. Both bounds must be 0 or both nonzero; a custom range needs at least two ports per session (64 with the default 32 sessions).

codexLiveMediaRelayICEServers.label: ICE servers
codexLiveMediaRelayICEServers.hint: Optional STUN/TURN servers using stun:, stuns:, turn:, or turns: URLs. TURN credentials are omitted from the JSON config API. Enter the credential as a password and keep secrets out of screenshots and logs.

remote.allow_remote_desc: Let other hosts open the management API and this panel. Off: localhost only.
remote.disable_panel_desc: Stop serving this web panel. The management API keeps working.
remote.disable_auto_update_panel_desc: Download the panel once when missing, never update it from GitHub afterwards.
remote.allow_remote_consequence: Anyone who can reach this port can try to log in. Remote clients need the management key to log in.
remote.allow_remote_confirm_message: The management API and this panel become reachable from other hosts. Make sure a management key is set before saving.
remote.secret_key_hint: Password for this panel and the management API. Empty: no key is required.
remote.secret_key_missing_warning: Remote access is on but no management key is set. Remote clients need this key to log in.
remote.panel_repo_hint: GitHub repository the panel is downloaded from. Empty: the built-in default.

auth.auth_dir_hint: Folder where OAuth credential files are stored. Supports ~ for the home directory.

system.debug_desc: Write verbose debug logs. Off by default; slows the gateway under load.
system.commercial_mode_desc: Turn off high-overhead middleware for high concurrency. Takes effect after a backend restart.
system.logging_to_file_desc: Write logs to files on the server instead of only to the console.
system.plugins_enabled_desc: Enable standard dynamic-library plugin loading; individual plugin instances are still managed on the Plugins page
system.plugin_store_sources_desc: Append plugin-store registry sources; the built-in official source is always kept
system.plugin_store_sources_hint: One registry.json URL per row. Empty rows are filtered on save
system.plugin_store_auth_desc: Configure auth headers for private registries, GitHub Release metadata, or artifact downloads
system.plugin_store_auth_hint: Enter environment variable names only, not actual tokens. The backend reads the values from its runtime environment.
system.store_auth_empty: No auth rules are configured. Public plugin sources do not need one.
system.store_auth_apply_to_hint: When nothing is selected, the rule applies to all request types.
system.usage_statistics_enabled_desc: Aggregate request usage in memory so the dashboard can show it. Off: usage pages stay empty.
system.redis_usage_retention_hint: Seconds to keep RESP LPOP/RPOP usage output in memory. Maximum 3600. 0 or empty: default.
system.antigravity_sensitive_words_desc: Insert zero-width characters into matching words in Antigravity system instructions to reduce exact keyword matching upstream
system.antigravity_sensitive_words_hint: One word or phrase per row. Matching is case-insensitive; empty entries are removed and entries shorter than 2 characters are ignored by the backend
system.devin_sensitive_words_desc: In Devin system prompts only, a line containing a configured word is removed in full; the remaining system prompt is then obfuscated. Regular messages and tool arguments are not changed
system.devin_sensitive_words_hint: One word or phrase per row. Configure carefully: matching content causes the entire system-prompt line to be deleted; empty entries are removed when saved
system.antigravity_signature_cache_desc: Prefer and validate cached thinking-block signatures
system.antigravity_signature_strict_desc: Only applies when the signature cache is disabled; validates the full Claude protobuf tree
system.logs_max_size_hint: Total size of log files to keep, in MB. Oldest files are removed first. 0 or empty: no limit.
system.error_logs_max_files_hint: How many error log files to retain before the oldest is deleted. 0 or empty: keep all.

headers.title: Header defaults
headers.description: Default headers for Claude and Codex OAuth requests when the client omits them.
headers.stabilize_device_desc: Pin OS and architecture and keep the software fingerprint stable per credential or API key.
headers.user_agent_hint: User-Agent sent upstream when the client omits one. Empty: the backend default.
headers.package_version_hint: Client package version reported upstream. Empty: the backend default.
headers.runtime_version_hint: Runtime (for example Node) version reported upstream. Empty: the backend default.
headers.os_hint: Operating system name reported upstream. Empty: the backend default.
headers.arch_hint: CPU architecture reported upstream, for example x64 or arm64. Empty: the backend default.
headers.timeout_hint: Timeout header value sent upstream. Empty: the backend default.
headers.beta_features_hint: OpenAI-Beta header value sent upstream. Empty: the backend default.

network.title: Network
network.description: Outbound proxy, retries, credential routing, cooldowns, and media handling.
network.max_retry_credentials_hint: How many different credentials to try before giving up. Empty: unset. 0 or negative: try all available credentials.
network.max_retry_interval_hint: Longest cooldown wait between retry rounds, in seconds. 0 or negative: skip the wait.
network.auth_auto_refresh_workers_hint: Parallel workers that refresh OAuth tokens. Default 16. 0, negative, or empty: use the default.
network.disable_image_generation_hint: Whether the gateway injects its image generation tool into requests.
network.gpt_image_2_base_model_hint: Mainline model used to serve gpt-image-2 requests. Empty or invalid: the backend default.
network.routing_strategy_hint: Which credential handles the next request. Default: round robin.
network.force_model_prefix_desc: Requests without a model prefix only use credentials that have no prefix either.
network.passthrough_headers_desc: Forward filtered upstream response headers to the client.
network.disable_cooling_desc: Skip all credential and model cooldown windows after failures.
network.ws_auth_desc: Require authentication for AI Studio WebSocket connections (oauth.providers.aistudio.ws-auth).
network.proxy_url_hint: Proxy for all upstream requests, for example http://host:port or socks5://host:port. Empty: connect directly.
network.group_retries_desc: What happens when an upstream request fails.
network.request_retry_hint: How many times to retry a failed upstream request. Default 3. 0: never retry.
network.group_routing_desc: How a credential is picked for each request.
network.strategy_round_robin_desc: Cycle through credentials in order so load is spread evenly.
network.strategy_weighted_round_robin_desc: Like round robin, but credentials with a higher weight get more requests.
network.strategy_fill_first_desc: Keep using the first healthy credential until it fails or hits quota, then move to the next.
network.session_affinity_desc: Keep a conversation on the same credential while it stays active, so upstream caches keep working.
network.session_affinity_ttl_hint: Seconds of inactivity before a conversation may move to another credential. 0 or empty: the backend default.
network.group_cooldowns_desc: How long a failing credential or model is rested before it is used again.
network.disable_cooling_consequence: Failing credentials are retried immediately, which can burn quota and trigger upstream rate limits.
network.disable_image_generation_false_desc: Default. The image tool is available on all endpoints.
network.disable_image_generation_true_desc: No image generation on any endpoint.
network.disable_image_generation_chat_desc: The tool is not injected into chat endpoints; dedicated image endpoints still work.
network.disable_image_generation_passthrough_des: Keep the client tool list as sent; nothing is injected.
network.group_more_desc: Rarely changed: refresh workers, model prefix, header passthrough, WebSocket auth.

quota.title: Quota fallback
quota.description: What the gateway does when a credential runs out of quota.
quota.switch_project_desc: Move to another project automatically when quota is exceeded.
quota.switch_preview_model_desc: Fall back to the preview model version when quota is exceeded.
quota.intro: These switches only control fallback behaviour. Current usage and limits are on the Quota page.
quota.antigravity_credits_desc: Spend Antigravity credits when the regular quota is exhausted.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: Keepalive pings and retries before the first byte arrives.
streaming.keepalive_hint: Seconds between keepalive pings on streaming responses. 0, negative, or empty: disabled.
streaming.bootstrap_hint: Retries if the stream fails before the first byte. 0, negative, or empty: disabled.
streaming.nonstream_keepalive_hint: Send a blank line every N seconds on non-streaming responses so proxies do not time out. 0, negative, or empty: disabled.

payload.title: Payload rules
payload.description: Default values, raw JSON rules, overrides, and filters applied to request bodies.
payload.default_rules_desc: Use these default values when parameters are not specified in the request
payload.default_raw_rules_desc: When parameters are missing, write these values as raw JSON fragments such as true, 123, "high", or {"type":"object"}
payload.override_rules_desc: Force override parameter values in the request
payload.override_raw_rules_desc: Always overwrite parameter values as raw JSON fragments, useful for response_format, schemas, and other complex fields
payload.filter_rules_desc: Pre-filter upstream request body via JSON Path, automatically remove non-compliant/redundant parameters (Request Sanitization)

api_keys.label: Client API keys
api_keys.empty: No API keys yet. Any client can call the gateway without a key.
api_keys.hint: Keys that clients send to call this gateway. Empty means any client can call it without a key. Changes take effect after you save.
api_keys.name_hint: Saved immediately in this browser only, separately for each server. Not included in server configuration. Clear this field to remove the name.
api_keys.name_save_error: Could not save the name in browser storage. Check your browser storage settings.
api_keys.input_hint: Changes take effect after saving the configuration. Upstream provider keys are managed separately.

payload_rules.value_raw_json: Raw JSON fragment, e.g. true, 123, "high", or {"type":"object"}

validation.port_range: Enter a valid port between 1 and 65535
validation.integer_range_1_3600: Enter a whole number between 1 and 3600

behavior.title: Provider-specific behavior
behavior.alphaSearchHint: Allow this Codex key to serve Alpha Search. The upstream must support it.
behavior.codexCloakingHint: Override official Codex identity headers for this API key. Default removes the credential override; OAuth-only settings do not apply here.
behavior.rebuildMidSystemMessageHint: Move Claude messages with role system into the top-level system field.
behavior.supportPromptCacheKeyHint: Derive and inject prompt_cache_key for compatible requests. Enable only when the upstream supports this field.

modelOptions.contextHint: Non-negative integer; leave empty to use the default.
modelOptions.modalitiesHint: Separate values with commas or whitespace. Custom modality names are preserved.
modelOptions.thinkingHint: Default inherits backend behavior; an empty custom override is an explicit {}. Budgets and effort levels can coexist. Only when both budgets are 0 or blank is the numeric range unspecified. Set a maximum at least as large as a positive minimum.
modelOptions.invalidContext: Context length must be a non-negative safe integer.
modelOptions.invalidThinking: Thinking must be a valid JSON object.
modelOptions.invalidBudget: Thinking budgets must be non-negative safe integers.
modelOptions.invalidRange: Minimum thinking budget must not exceed the maximum. Blank bounds count as 0.

runtimePolicy.title: Advanced runtime policy
runtimePolicy.description: Inherit uses the parent group policy, then backend defaults. Overrides apply only to this entry.
runtimePolicy.retryHint: Blank inherits the group setting. Use an integer: 0 disables retries; a negative value uses the global retry policy instead of the group policy.
runtimePolicy.errorsHint: Inherit follows the parent policy. Override replaces the entire list, which may be empty. Switching modes keeps your rule draft.
runtimePolicy.invalidRetry: Retries must be a safe integer, or blank to inherit.

errorRules.hint: Use the first matching rule in order; for the same status code, any condition may match.
errorRules.empty: No rules. You can save an empty list.
errorRules.invalidStatus: Status code must be a positive safe integer.
errorRules.missingMatch: Add at least one match condition.

claude_reset.title: Banked resets

claude_reset.not_limited: No reset: the account is not currently limited.
